legacy_card_resource.title: Migrate the Device Health dashboard resource

init.title: Migrate the Device Health dashboard resource
init.description: First remove the old Device Health Dashboard installation in HACS and confirm its resource has disappeared in Settings → Dashboards → Resources. If you installed it manually, remove only its old Device Health resource there. Do not delete your dashboard cards. Then submit this repair: it checks for remaining copies and registers the Integration resource. Refresh your browser after it succeeds. For YAML resources, follow the README instead.

error.legacy_resource_remains: An old Device Health resource is still present. Remove it and try again.
error.resources_unavailable: Resources are unavailable or managed in YAML. Follow the README for manual migration.
